title: Dubai Chamber debuts in Korea to woo investors
caption:
The Dubai Chamber of Commerce has opened its first office in Seoul to encourage Korean companies to invest directly in the UAE. The initiative aims to shift the focus from simple exports to long-term business partnerships.
